app.name: KrishiConnect
app.subTagline: Digital agriculture platform connecting farmers, buyers and experts across Maharashtra

landing.heroDesc: Hyper-local weather insights, growth-stage crop management, farmer peer discussions, and direct produce markets — all in one accessible platform.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Tailored for smallholder farmers and agricultural communities in Maharashtra
landing.weatherFeatureDesc: Localized forecasts, precipitation risk alerts, and timely field activity schedules.
landing.cropsFeatureDesc: Sowing-to-harvest timelines with scheduled irrigation, fertilizer, and pest reminders.
landing.communityFeatureDesc: Exchange field experience with progressive farmers and agronomy specialists.
landing.marketFeatureDesc: Direct buyer connection without middlemen; fair prices and transparent enquiries.
landing.schemesFeatureDesc: Clear guidelines and official portal links for MahaDBT subsidies and crop insurance.
landing.expertsFeatureDesc: Accredited specialist consultations for complex pest and disease issues.
landing.capstoneNotice: Note: Built as a final-year Capstone demonstration. Phase 1 provides the responsive foundation, design system, and mobile shell.

status.offlineBanner: You are currently offline. Previously loaded guides are accessible, but live updates require an internet connection.

farming.disclaimer: Note: Biological timeline is approximate. Actual growth varies with weather and soil.

community.title: Farmer Community & Discussions
community.subtitle: Discuss with fellow farmers, ask agronomy questions, and receive reliable advice from verified university experts

marketplace.title: Direct Agricultural Marketplace
marketplace.subtitle: Connect directly with local buyers and farmers without intermediaries and trade produce at transparent prices
marketplace.directPolicyNotice: Phase 1 direct contact: No on-platform payments or logistics. Buyers and farmers connect directly, inspect produce in person, and transact via Cash/UPI.

schemes.title: Government Agricultural Schemes
schemes.subtitle: Discover verified subsidies and welfare schemes from Maharashtra and Central Governments

learning.title: Agricultural Learning Centre
learning.subtitle: Practical guides, tutorials, and research-backed best practices for modern farming

weather.title: Local Agricultural Weather
